summary: This document replaces some terminology in OSPF with wording in line with inclusive language used in the industry, following guidance from the US National Institute of Standards and Technology. Future OSPF documents are meant to use the new terms, even when referring to the older RFCs it updates. It changes words, not protocol behavior.

eli5.summary: Some words in an old rulebook were swapped for kinder, clearer ones. The game works exactly the same way. Only the labels changed.
